alina: FYI onboarding trident11b (HF -> internal) showed a surprising quality regression after our int4 profile. looks like a layout mismatch rather than pure quant noise.
tom: Numbers? small smoke table?
alina: quick smoke:
```
model             | rouge1 | next-ppl | lat/token
trident11b-fp16   | 0.47   | 8.7      | 13ms
trident11b-int4   | 0.37   | 13.9     | 6.0ms
trident11b-int4-remap | 0.44 | 9.9     | 6.2ms
```
alina: remap = runtime apply head_map-aware sin/cos indexing. recovers most of the drop.
kevin: Did the converter drop per_head_dims or flatten head groups? we've seen converters collapse hetero heads into uniform groups.
alina: yes: upstream header had per_head_dims = [32,32,16,48, ...] and explicit head_map. converter output normalized to groups of equal dims and omitted head_map.
nina: That will mis-index rotary sin/cos and also kv-cache stride. If cache stride != written projection layout, reads misalign and amplify quantization error.
tom: Concrete mitigations: 1) reconvert preserving per_head_dims+head_map and plumb mapping through runtime (sincos + cache stride) 2) short-term: int4 with rotary disabled or runtime remap that shuffles projection subvectors to converted layout.
kevin: Also try per-channel calibration for quantizing projection matrices. sometimes that reduces extreme logit shifts.
alina: I'll kick off these runs:
 - 1755812345-01: reconvert-preserve-headmap + int4 quant (long)
 - 1755812345-02: int4 quant + rotary-disabled (quick)
 - 1755812345-03: int4-remap-runtime (shuffle at runtime)
 - 1755812345-04: per-channel-int4 calibration (quick)
bench-bot: Queued jobs 1755812345-01..04. ETA 40-120m depending on GPU queue.
nina: Also add logit-diff / topk hist (200 prompts) and a single-token 5k-seed KL micro-test to catch steady drift.
tom: If reconversion fixes it, add a unit test in converter: random head_map roundtrip -> verify sincos index mapping equals projection offsets. Also gate auto-quant to warn on head_map normalization.
alina: will post outputs and a bad example completion. thanks all :rocket:
